summary: Catherine Stefani voted against a January 2024 San Francisco Board resolution calling for an immediate ceasefire in Gaza, arguing it required Hamas surrender and hostage return, and in committee emphasized the sexual violence Israeli women suffered during the October 7 attack. She recorded an aye on AB 715, the state bill creating an antisemitism coordinator and classroom-material oversight. California Jewish Democrats, the renamed Democrats for Israel California, endorsed her at the Support tier.
